title: CMX-377: calm desktop-app dashboard restyle
why: the .canvas must sit in .app's only grid row; a leftover grid-row: 2 (from the removed topbar row) pushed the whole Wall off-screen (#529)

title: CMX-391: a transcript's fake PR can't close a run
why: the run row's daemon-recorded pr_url must win over a PR url read from the session transcript; trusting the transcript first closed a live run on a test fixture's fake PR (CMX-391)

title: CMX-390: strip pm2's Node IPC env from every hook, suite and tmux launch
why: a workflow hook launched without env=child_env() inherits pm2's NODE_CHANNEL_FD and any Node program in it (pnpm) aborts 134 (CMX-390)

before: if self._sandbox_checked_at is None or now - self._sandbox_checked_at >= SANDBOX_RECHECK_INTERVAL:
title: CMX-403: guests type only into a verified sandboxed session
why: the sandbox verdict gating guest typing must be re-checked every SANDBOX_RECHECK_INTERVAL; caching the first check lets a window that stops being sandboxed keep accepting guest input (CMX-403)
